Amar Dedic.note: Dedić has been part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Amar Dedic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Amar Memic.note: Memić gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Amar Memic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Amir Hadziahmetovic.note: Hadžiahmetović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Arjan Malic.note: Malić is defensive cover for Bosnia and Herzegovina's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Arjan Malic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Armin Gigovic.note: Gigović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Armin Gigovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Benjamin Tahirovic.note: Tahirović gives Bosnia and Herzegovina midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Benjamin Tahirovic.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Dennis Hadzikadunic.note: Hadžikadunić has supplied one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Bosnia and Herzegovina创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Dzenis Burnic.note: Burnić is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Bosnia and Herzegovina, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Dzenis Burnic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Edin Dzeko.note: Džeko is one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Edin Dzeko.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Bosnia and Herzegovina来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Ermedin Demirovic.note: Demirović is part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's attacking shape, even when he is not the finisher. His movement decides who gets the next clear touch.
Ermedin Demirovic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ermin Mahmic.note: Mahmić has been one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's real scoring stories, with goals against Switzerland and Qatar. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Ermin Mahmic.noteZh: 他已经多次为Bosnia and Herzegovina把机会变成进球。看他需要的空间有多小。

Esmir Bajraktarevic.note: Bajraktarević gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Esmir Bajraktarevic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Haris Tabakovic.note: Tabaković is attacking depth for Bosnia and Herzegovina. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Haris Tabakovic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Ivan Basic.note: Bašić has one tournament assist in the bank for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Ivan Basic.noteZh: 他已经帮Bosnia and Herzegovina制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Ivan Sunjic.note: Šunjić is a tempo player for Bosnia and Herzegovina. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ivan Sunjic.noteZh: 他让Bosnia and Herzegovina在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Jovo Lukic.note: Lukić is on the scoresheet for Bosnia and Herzegovina, with his goal coming against Canada. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Jovo Lukic.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Kerim Alajbegovic.note: Alajbegović already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Qatar. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Kerim Alajbegovic.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Martin Zlomislic.note: Zlomislić is goalkeeper cover for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Martin Zlomislic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Mladen Jurkas.note: Jurkas sits behind the starter for Bosnia and Herzegovina, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Mladen Jurkas.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Nihad Mujakic.note: Mujakić gives Bosnia and Herzegovina cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Nihad Mujakic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nikola Katic.note: Katić is in the quiet-work part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Nikola Katic.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Nikola Vasilj.note: Vasilj is the last voice in Bosnia and Herzegovina's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Nikola Vasilj.noteZh: 他承担了Bosnia and Herzegovina的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Samed Bazdar.note: Baždar gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Samed Bazdar.noteZh: 他是Bosnia and Herzegovina在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Sead Kolasinac.note: Kolašinac has supplied one of Bosnia and Herzegovina's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Sead Kolasinac.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Bosnia and Herzegovina创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Stjepan Radeljic.note: Radeljić is defensive rotation for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Stjepan Radeljic.noteZh: 他给Bosnia and Herzegovina那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Tarik Muharemovic.note: Muharemović has been part of Bosnia and Herzegovina's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Tarik Muharemovic.noteZh: 他在Bosnia and Herzegovina体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。
